title: Mortgage servicing errors and information requests
facts: Federal Regulation X provides procedures for borrowers to notify covered mortgage servicers of specified servicing errors and request certain information.
A written notice should identify the borrower and account and describe the error or information requested with enough detail for the servicer to investigate.
Servicers generally have acknowledgment and response deadlines under federal rules, with timing varying by request type and circumstances.
Borrowers should use the servicer's designated address for notices of error or information requests when one has been properly designated.
